card.line: Ahava was a canal or stream where Ezra gathered people returning from captivity before their trip from Babylon to Jerusalem, and where they fasted and asked God for protection.

moments.title: Gathering at the canal
moments.text: Ezra gathered the people returning from captivity at the canal that flows to Ahava, and they camped there three days. He searched the people and priests and found no Levites, so he sent leaders to Casiphia to ask for people to serve in the house of God.

moments.title: A fast for a safe journey
moments.text: At the Ahava Canal Ezra announced a fast so they could humble themselves and ask God for a safe journey. He was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers, so they trusted God, and He granted their request.

moments.title: Setting out for Jerusalem
moments.text: On the twelfth day of the first month they left the Ahava Canal for Jerusalem. The hand of God was upon them and protected them from enemies and bandits along the way.
